notes.text: Codification Sections 40 and 41, relating to Territory of Alaska, were omitted in view of admission of Alaska into the Union. Section 40, act June 6, 1900, ch. 786, § 31, 31 Stat. 332, related to court rooms and offices of civil government. Section 41, acts Jan. 27, 1905, ch. 277, § 1, 33 Stat. 616; May 14, 1906, ch. 2458, § 1, 34 Stat. 192; Feb. 6, 1909, ch. 80, § 7, 35 Stat. 601; Mar. 3, 1913, ch. 109, 37 Stat. 728, related to deposits to Alaska fund in Treasury Department.
